title: Microsoft SMTP AUTH Basic Auth Deprecation: What Breaks in December
meta_description: Microsoft switches off password logins for SMTP AUTH by default at the end of December 2026. What breaks in cold email, and the report that finds it today.
secondary_keywords: office 365 smtp basic authentication end of life
exchange online smtp auth basic authentication december 2026
outlook inbox cold email smtp basic auth

image.takeaway: Basic auth for SMTP AUTH is off by default in existing tenants from the end of December 2026. OAuth is supported.
image.alt: Microsoft SMTP AUTH Basic auth deprecation: password logins to smtp.office365.com are off by default in existing tenants from the end of December 2026
